coverage.subclasses: 12 of 48 — the SRD includes exactly one subclass per class
coverage.species: 9 of 10 — Aasimar is not in the SRD

_meta.notes: Every row below carries source + license so takedown provenance is answerable in one query. Seed ONLY from the SRD PDF — never from wikis, D&D Beyond, or scraped datasets, which mix in non-SRD content.

abilities.name: Strength
abilities.blurb: Lifting, hitting hard, kicking down doors.

abilities.name: Dexterity
abilities.blurb: Aim, reflexes, sneaking, staying out of the way.

abilities.name: Constitution
abilities.blurb: Stamina, and how much punishment you can take.

abilities.name: Charisma
abilities.blurb: Force of personality. Talking your way out of it.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.blurb: Descended from dragons. You breathe elemental death and grow wings.
species.meta: Breath weapon, damage resistance, flight at level 5

species.name: Dwarf
species.blurb: Sturdy, stubborn, and at home in stone. The toughest species in the book.
species.meta: +1 HP per level, poison resistance, 120 ft darkvision

species.name: Elf
species.blurb: Long-lived, keen-eyed, and hard to charm. Three quite different lineages.
species.meta: Free skill, charm resistance, no sleep needed

species.name: Gnome
species.blurb: Curious, inventive, quick-minded. The best mental saves in the game.
species.meta: Advantage on all INT, WIS and CHA saves

species.name: Goliath
species.blurb: Giant-blooded, towering, and faster than everyone else.
species.meta: 35 ft speed, carry as if Large, a giant power

species.name: Halfling
species.blurb: Small, lucky, and braver than they look. Reroll your 1s.
species.meta: Luck, fear immunity-ish, hide behind bigger creatures

species.name: Human
species.blurb: Adaptable and everywhere. Mechanically the most flexible starting point.
species.meta: A free Origin feat, a free skill, and Heroic Inspiration daily

species.name: Orc
species.blurb: Powerful and relentless. Very hard to actually put down.
species.meta: Drop to 1 HP instead of 0, once per long rest

species.name: Tiefling
species.blurb: Touched by the lower planes. Innate spellcasting from your legacy.
species.meta: Free spells that scale with level, plus Thaumaturgy

lineages.name: Drow
lineages.blurb: Underdark elves. Superior darkvision and innate spells.

lineages.name: High Elf
lineages.blurb: Scholarly elves. A wizard cantrip you can swap on a long rest.

lineages.name: Wood Elf
lineages.blurb: Fast and stealthy. 35 ft speed and Druidcraft.

lineages.name: Forest Gnome
lineages.blurb: Minor Illusion and you can talk to small animals.

lineages.name: Fire's Burn
lineages.blurb: Extra fire damage when you hit.

lineages.name: Frost's Chill
lineages.blurb: Cold damage and slow the target.

lineages.name: Storm's Thunder
lineages.blurb: Reaction: thunder damage to your attacker.

lineages.name: Abyssal Legacy
lineages.blurb: Poison resistance. Poison Spray, Ray of Sickness, Hold Person.

lineages.name: Chthonic Legacy
lineages.blurb: Necrotic resistance. Chill Touch, False Life, Ray of Enfeeblement.

lineages.name: Infernal Legacy
lineages.blurb: Fire resistance. Fire Bolt, Hellish Rebuke, Darkness.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.blurb: Rage, resistance to damage, and the highest hit points in the game.
classes.meta: The simplest class to play and one of the most fun. Charge in first.

classes.name: Bard
classes.blurb: Magic, skills, and making everyone else better at their job.
classes.meta: Support class that is never boring. Can pick any three skills.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.blurb: Divine magic, healing, and surprisingly decent armour.
classes.meta: Always in demand, tougher than people expect. Never a wasted turn.

classes.name: Druid
classes.blurb: Nature magic and, from level 2, turning into animals.
classes.meta: Enormously versatile. Wild Shape is the most fun button in the game.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.blurb: Every weapon, every armour, and more attacks than anyone.
classes.meta: Good if you want to charge in first and still be standing after.

classes.name: Monk
classes.blurb: Unarmed strikes, absurd mobility, and no armour at all.
classes.meta: Fast and slippery. Rewards players who like moving around the battlefield.
classes.weapons: Simple weapons and martial weapons with the Light property

classes.name: Paladin
classes.blurb: Heavy armour, an oath, and the ability to dump damage into one hit.
classes.meta: Tanky and terrifying. Divine Smite is the biggest single hit at low levels.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.blurb: Wilderness expert, skilled tracker, and a bit of nature magic.
classes.meta: Best skill spread of the martial classes. Strong at range.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.blurb: Sneak attacks, locks, traps, and lies.
classes.meta: Most skills of any class. Great if you like solving problems sideways.
classes.weapons: Simple weapons and martial weapons with Finesse or Light

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.blurb: Innate magic you bend and reshape on the fly. Fewest spells, most flexibility.
classes.meta: Metamagic lets you break the rules of your own spells. Very fragile.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.blurb: A pact with something powerful. Few spell slots, but they recharge on a short rest.
classes.meta: Eldritch Blast all day. The most distinctive caster in the game.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.blurb: A book of spells and a low pain threshold.
classes.meta: The most versatile class in the game. Very fragile at low levels.

subclasses.name: Path of the Berserker
subclasses.blurb: Frenzy. More attacks, more damage, no subtlety whatsoever.

subclasses.name: College of Lore
subclasses.blurb: Cutting Words and extra skills. Steal spells from any class.

subclasses.name: Life Domain
subclasses.blurb: Healing above all. Every heal you cast does more.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.blurb: Extra spells tied to a terrain, and recover slots on a short rest.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.blurb: Crit on 19-20, and it gets better. Almost no bookkeeping.
subclasses.meta: Best first-ever character in the game.

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
subclasses.blurb: Push, trip, or stun with your flurry. Heal yourself later.

subclasses.name: Oath of Devotion
subclasses.blurb: The knight in shining armour. Protect allies, smite the wicked.

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.blurb: Pick your prey and specialise your damage against it.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.blurb: Fast hands, second-storey work, and using magic items you shouldn't.

subclasses.name: Draconic Sorcery
subclasses.blurb: Dragon blood. More HP, natural armour, and wings later.

subclasses.name: Fiend Patron
subclasses.blurb: A devil backs you. Temporary HP on every kill.

subclasses.name: Evoker
subclasses.blurb: Blow things up without hitting your friends.
subclasses.meta: Sculpt Spells is the best level-3 feature in the game.

backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.blurb: You served in a temple. You know the rites and the politics.

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.blurb: You made your living outside the law. You still know people.

backgrounds.name: Sage
backgrounds.blurb: You spent years with books. You know where to look things up.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.blurb: You trained and fought as part of an army. You know how to take a hit.

feats.name: Alert
feats.blurb: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative, and swap Initiative with a willing ally.
feats.meta: Going first is worth more than almost anything else.

feats.name: Magic Initiate
feats.blurb: Learn two cantrips and one level-1 spell from a chosen class's list.
feats.meta: The most flexible origin feat. Repeatable.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.blurb: Once per turn, reroll your weapon's damage dice and use either total.
feats.meta: Quietly excellent on big two-handed weapons.

feats.name: Skilled
feats.blurb: Gain proficiency in any three skills or tools.
feats.meta: Repeatable. Turns any character into a generalist.

feats.name: Ability Score Improvement
feats.blurb: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each. Max 20.

feats.name: Grappler
feats.blurb: Advantage on attacks against creatures you grapple, and you can drag them along.
feats.meta: Strong on any character built around control.

feats.name: Archery
feats.blurb: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

feats.name: Defense
feats.meta: Never a bad pick. Always applies.

feats.name: Great Weapon Fighting
feats.blurb: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage with two-handed or versatile weapons.

feats.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
feats.blurb: Add your ability modifier to the damage of your second attack.

feats.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
feats.blurb: Once per turn, turn a miss into a hit.

feats.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
feats.blurb: Cast Misty Step as a bonus action, twice per long rest, without a slot.

feats.name: Boon of Fate
feats.blurb: Add 2d4 to a d20 test made by you or a creature within 60 feet.

feats.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
feats.blurb: Your weapon damage ignores resistance and immunity.

feats.name: Boon of Spell Recall
feats.blurb: Cast level 1-4 spells without expending a slot, once each per long rest.

feats.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
feats.blurb: Become Invisible and take half damage while in dim light or darkness.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.blurb: Hurl acid at one or two creatures.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.blurb: Necrotic damage at range; target can't regain HP.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.blurb: Up to four floating lights you can move.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.blurb: Small nature effects. Predict the weather.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.blurb: The warlock's signature. Scales with level.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.blurb: Ranged spell attack, 1d10 fire.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.blurb: +1d4 to an ally's ability check.

spells.name: Light
spells.blurb: An object sheds bright light.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.blurb: A spectral hand that fetches things.

spells.name: Mending
spells.blurb: Repair a single break or tear.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.blurb: A small sound or image. Endlessly abusable.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.blurb: A puff of poison at close range.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.blurb: Minor magical tricks. Endlessly useful.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.blurb: A flame in your hand: light it or throw it.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.blurb: Cold damage and slows the target.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.blurb: Radiant damage that ignores cover.

spells.name: Shillelagh
spells.blurb: Your club uses your spellcasting ability.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.blurb: Lightning; target can't take reactions.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.blurb: Stabilise a dying creature at range.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.blurb: Minor signs of supernatural power.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.blurb: Insult someone into taking damage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.blurb: +1d4 to allies' attacks and saves.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.blurb: A 15-foot cone of fire.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.blurb: Make a humanoid friendly to you.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.blurb: A 4d8 orb of the damage type you pick.

spells.name: Command
spells.blurb: One-word order the target must obey.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.blurb: Understand any spoken or written language.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.blurb: Touch to heal 2d8 + modifier.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.blurb: Sense aberrations, celestials, fiends and undead.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.blurb: Sense magic within 30 feet.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.blurb: Change your appearance.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.blurb: Psychic damage and the target flees.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.blurb: Your weapon deals extra radiant damage.

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.blurb: Vines restrain the creature you hit.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.blurb: Grasping weeds restrain everyone in a square.

spells.name: Expeditious Retreat
spells.blurb: Dash as a bonus action every turn.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.blurb: Outlines creatures; advantage to hit them.

spells.name: False Life
spells.blurb: Temporary hit points.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.blurb: Reaction: falling creatures drift down safely.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.blurb: A spirit companion in animal form.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.blurb: A 20-foot sphere of heavy obscurement.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.blurb: Ten berries, each healing 1 HP and feeding you.

spells.name: Grease
spells.blurb: Slick ground; creatures fall prone.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.blurb: 4d6 radiant and advantage on the next attack.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.blurb: Bonus-action heal at range.

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.blurb: Reaction: set your attacker on fire.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.blurb: Immunity to Frightened plus temporary HP.

spells.name: Hex
spells.blurb: Extra damage to one target, and disadvantage on one ability.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.blurb: Extra damage to a target you keep hunting.

spells.name: Identify
spells.blurb: Learn a magic item's properties.

spells.name: Illusory Script
spells.blurb: Writing only chosen readers can understand.

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.blurb: Touch attack for heavy necrotic damage.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.blurb: +10 feet of speed for an hour.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.blurb: Base AC 13 + DEX for eight hours.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.blurb: Three darts that never miss.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.blurb: Ward against certain creature types.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.blurb: Attackers must pass a save to target the warded creature.

spells.name: Shield
spells.blurb: Reaction: +5 AC. Saves your life.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.blurb: +2 AC to a creature for ten minutes.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.blurb: A moving visual illusion.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.blurb: Knock weaker creatures unconscious.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.blurb: Talk to beasts.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.blurb: A wave of force that pushes everyone back.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.blurb: An invisible force that does chores.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.blurb: A sustained arc of lightning.

_excluded.note: Present in the 2024 Player's Handbook but NOT in the CC-BY SRD. Do not ship these. See docs/03-legal.md.
_excluded.subclasses: 36 of 48 — the SRD gives exactly one subclass per class
_excluded.feats: Roughly 58 further feats, including Lucky, Tough, Sentinel, Great Weapon Master, Sharpshooter, Polearm Master, War Caster, Resilient, Mobile, Crossbow Expert, Healer, Musician, Tavern Brawler, Athlete, Actor, Observant, Skulker, Mage Slayer, Elemental Adept, Ritual Caster, Spell Sniper, Telekinetic, Telepathic, Fey-Touched, Shadow-Touched, and the remaining Fighting Styles (Blind Fighting, Dueling, Interception, Protection, Thrown Weapon Fighting, Unarmed Fighting).
_excluded.howToOfferThemAnyway: Ship the engine, not the content. A user or a GM may author these as homebrew in their own ruleset — that is their legal exposure, not yours, and it is the same posture Foundry VTT takes.
